subject.title: fix(browser): bound client fetch success JSON reads

question: Should browser-control HTTP success responses fail once the JSON body exceeds the new 32 MiB cap?
rationale: The code fixes the buffering bug at the owner boundary, but it intentionally changes existing success behavior for oversized external browser-control services and needs current-head proof after the cap change.

options.title: Accept the 32 MiB cap after cleanup
options.body: Remove the changelog entry, refresh the latest-head proof, and merge with oversized success responses failing at 32 MiB.

options.title: Tune the browser contract first
options.body: Ask for a different browser-specific limit or clearer contract if supported browser responses may exceed 32 MiB.

options.title: Pause for product confirmation
options.body: Keep the PR open until browser-control payload expectations are confirmed enough to accept the fail-closed behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the 32 MiB cap after cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the changelog entry, refresh the latest-head proof, and merge with oversized success responses failing at 32 MiB.
